capabilities: Import single, multiple, or folder batches of xxl-job XML exports
Mirror the three-level job tree (flow, task, component) as one note per job
Generate Mermaid dependency graphs and parent-link sections with wikilinks
Apply configurable Markdown templates to the three generated note types
Resolve re-import conflicts by skipping, updating frontmatter, or creating renamed copies
extras: UI, settings, and generated notes are in Chinese (built for a Chinese-language vault), though parsing is language-agnostic. Actively developed source now lives in the Schema Studio repository; this repo remains the standalone distribution. No network access, telemetry, accounts, or paid tiers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn xxl-job job-definition XML exports into linked, templated Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: The same importer is integrated as a third domain tab (“xxl-job”) in Schema Studio.
Samples are in templates/fileclasses/ for vaults using the Fileclass plugin

summary: Imports xxl-job admin console XML exports into structured task flow, task, and task component notes with parent links and Mermaid graphs.
